weekend.en: Our family always goes for a walk together on the weekend.
weekend.cn: 我们一家周末总是一起散步。

Saturday.en: Every Saturday morning I have a piano lesson.
Saturday.cn: 每周六上午我有钢琴课。

Sunday.en: On Sunday afternoon we visit Grandma and Grandpa.
Sunday.cn: 周日下午我们去看爷爷奶奶。

park.en: In the park there are tall trees and a small lake.
park.cn: 公园里有高高的树和一个小湖。

shop.en: Mum and I shop for fruit at the market every Sunday.
shop.cn: 每周日我和妈妈去市场买水果。

movie.en: The new movie about space is really exciting.
movie.cn: 那部关于太空的新电影真精彩。

picnic.en: We had a picnic by the lake last Saturday afternoon.
picnic.cn: 上周六下午我们在湖边野餐。

fun.en: Spending time with friends and family is great fun.
fun.cn: 和朋友家人在一起最开心了。
